body_html:
What this page is

This is the consolidated reference section for the AI Governance Reference Library, every external source the library cites, in one place, exactly as a book carries its bibliography. The library’s accuracy claim rests on a simple discipline: every page is written from the primary instrument, the statute, the regulation, the enforcement release, the official framework text, not from secondary summaries, and every page carries attributed findings from peer-reviewed research. This page lists all of it: 78 primary sources across statutes, regulators, standards bodies, and official government publications, and 45 peer-reviewed or formally published research works. When a source conflicts with a widely repeated secondary claim, the library follows the source, which is where its recorded corrections come from. Links go directly to the issuing authority wherever one exists.
